profile.label: Hồ sơ
profile.title: Hồ sơ
profile.avatarDescription: Shown next to your name in bình luận, assignees, and thành viên.
profile.avatarFormats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF.
profile.detailsDescription: Your name appears across the app. Đăng nhập with your username or email.
profile.name: Tên
profile.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, and underscores. 3 to 30 characters.

security.label: Bảo mật
security.title: Bảo mật
security.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
security.passkeysDescription: Đăng nhập without a password using Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key.
security.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to đăng nhập without a password.
security.deleteWarning: You will no longer be able to đăng nhập with this passkey. This cannot be undone.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Connect external accounts to đăng nhập with them or receive thông báo there.
accounts.googleDescription: Đăng nhập with your Google account.
accounts.telegramWaiting: Waiting for you to press Start in the bot chat…

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How the app looks and behaves for you. Every change saves right away and applies wherever you đăng nhập.

sections.dateAndTimeDescription: Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in the zone you pick here.
sections.navigationDescription: Where the app takes you, and how issues open.
sections.issueSettingsDescription: How the stats and the activity log of an issue start out. Switching them while an issue is open does not change these.
sections.notificationsDescription: Watching an issue brings you its bình luận and trạng thái changes.
sections.shortcutsDescription: Press Change, then the keys you want. Reset takes a shortcut quay lại to the one set for this instance.

preferences.themeDescription: Match system follows your operating system setting.
preferences.languageDescription: The language of the interface, your emails, and the Telegram bot.
preferences.timezoneDescription: Pick the zone you work in.
preferences.issueOpenModeDescription: What happens when you click an issue on a board, table, calendar, or timeline.
preferences.startPageDescription: The section that opens when you enter the app, in your last active dự án.
preferences.showStatsDescription: Whether the stats section starts expanded when you open an issue.
preferences.statsViewDescription: Compact is one bar with a share per trạng thái; Timeline gives each trạng thái its own lane on a time axis.
preferences.activityViewDescription: Flat is every entry newest first; Grouped splits the log by the trạng thái the issue was in.
preferences.autoWatchDescription: The ones you tạo, get assigned, bình luận on, or are mentioned in.
preferences.showChatByDefaultDescription: The chat panel opens with a dự án page. Đóng it any time from its header or the chat icon.
